name: Ghostty
description: Ghostty's macOS updater uses Sparkle with an Info.plist SUPublicEDKey and SUEnableAutomaticChecks=false; the delegate disables automatic checks and retrieves while retaining a manual check action. Linux updater behavior and Sparkle internals remain outside this review.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; this is macOS evidence only.
Released signing, Sparkle internals, and Linux packaging/updater behavior are outside the reviewed source.
